evaluations.evidence: view a list of sponsors
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsor creation/management capabilities (e.g., sponsorship purchase and sponsor assignment), so viewing sponsors is supported by complementary stories.

evaluations.evidence: view a list of user profiles
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes account registration and profile update, which together provide the necessary creation/maintenance of profiles to be listed.

evaluations.evidence: email all the trainers at once
evaluations.rationale: Trainer entities and trainings are implied/covered by multiple training stories (training nodes, trainer views), providing the necessary basis for contacting trainers.

evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes venue creation/maintenance and venue details viewing, which can supply the location data needed for maps.

evaluations.evidence: edit my training node myself
evaluations.rationale: Editing a training node presupposes that training nodes can be created/initially entered; backlog has many stories to view trainings but no explicit story to create/submit/manage training offerings (beyond editing by trainer). Missing complementary capability: create training offering/training node.

evaluations.evidence: limit to one registration per day per authenticated user
evaluations.rationale: Backlog contains multiple training registration workflow stories (waitlist, cancellation terms/deadline, viewing signed-up trainings), indicating registration exists to constrain.

evaluations.evidence: admin view that helps track registration status
evaluations.rationale: Training registration is implied by multiple stories; an admin view complements that workflow rather than exposing a missing prerequisite.

evaluations.evidence: be added to a training waitlist
evaluations.rationale: Waitlisting presupposes training registration/capacity; backlog includes training registration-related constraints and views, supporting the existence of registration to extend with waitlist.

evaluations.evidence: must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox
evaluations.rationale: This is a step within a registration/cancellation workflow that is referenced elsewhere; it does not reveal a missing complementary capability by itself.

evaluations.evidence: tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists
evaluations.rationale: Backlog references cancellation workflow but does not include an explicit story enabling trainees to cancel a training registration (the complementary capability needed for a cancellation deadline to apply). Missing: cancel training registration.

evaluations.evidence: add to "my schedule" if there is a schedule feature on the site
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes viewing the schedule but no explicit capability to create/manage a personal schedule (add/remove items) beyond this conditional story. Missing complementary capability: define/maintain 'my schedule' feature (including removal/management).

evaluations.evidence: see which trainings I have signed up for

evaluations.evidence: admin view where all trainee information is shown and can be filtered
evaluations.rationale: Complements existing implied training registration and attendee data; does not expose a missing prerequisite beyond those already covered by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: dedicated page for each class ... link to register for class
evaluations.rationale: Backlog contains multiple stories implying training registration and related workflows; class detail pages fit within that set.

evaluations.evidence: training options clearly marked ... register now link
evaluations.rationale: Training listing with registration links is supported by other training registration workflow stories; does not itself reveal a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: promote call for trainings
evaluations.rationale: A 'call for trainings' implies trainers can submit/propose trainings for selection, but backlog lacks an explicit story to submit a training proposal/offering (creation). Missing complementary capability: submit/propose training offering for review/selection.

evaluations.evidence: link on the home page to a list of training options
evaluations.rationale: Training list pages are covered (landing/listing/detail), so adding a home-page link does not expose a missing prerequisite.

evaluations.evidence: find out where the coding lounge is and what time it is open
evaluations.rationale: This requires coding lounge content (location/hours) to be created/maintained, but backlog has no story to create/manage coding lounge info (or a general facility-hours content type). Missing complementary capability: maintain coding lounge details/hours.

evaluations.evidence: refund sponsorship money that was processed via stripe
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsorship payment/checkout stories, providing the prerequisite transactions to refund.

evaluations.evidence: link ... to become a $350 level sponsor

evaluations.evidence: identify myself as and pay for a $350 company sponsorship
evaluations.rationale: Payment capture and payment page steps exist in the backlog, supporting this sponsorship purchase flow.

evaluations.evidence: create and maintain venues
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes viewing venue details and directions to venues, which are complementary read/use cases for venue data.

evaluations.evidence: view venue details
evaluations.rationale: Venue creation/maintenance is explicitly present, so viewing venue details has its prerequisite covered.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of the sessions associated with sponsor attendees
evaluations.rationale: Requires (1) attendee-to-sponsor/company association and (2) attendee-to-session association (attendance/participation), neither of which is explicitly created/maintained in backlog. evaluations.evidence: See a payment page ... third step of the registration process
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes entering payment info and charging cards for sponsorships, supporting the payment page step.

evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes admin assignment of sponsors to events/trainings/summits, which is the prerequisite for this view.

evaluations.evidence: Enter payment information and have my card charged
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsorship selection and payment page steps; charging the card is the complementary execution step.

evaluations.evidence: link BADCamp attendees to my sponsorship page
evaluations.rationale: Linking attendees to a sponsorship page requires a mechanism to associate specific attendee accounts with a sponsor (and likely sponsor control/verification). Backlog lacks explicit story to create/manage these attendee-sponsor links. Missing complementary capability: manage attendee-to-sponsor association.

evaluations.evidence: update my user profile

evaluations.evidence: create blog posts

evaluations.evidence: read the blog

Missing complementary capability: summit sponsorship purchase flow.

evaluations.evidence: get detailed directions to the summit venue
evaluations.rationale: Venue creation/maintenance and venue details viewing exist, providing the necessary location data for directions.

evaluations.evidence: see what summits I'm signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Summit registration is present, and this is a complementary read capability for that registration data.

evaluations.evidence: list basic information about my summit

evaluations.evidence: list an agenda for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Summit detail viewing exists; agenda listing is a content creation capability that complements those views without exposing a missing prerequisite.

evaluations.evidence: see how many seats are left for the summit
evaluations.rationale: Seat counts depend on summit registration, which is included; thus the necessary complementary capability exists.

evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes authenticated session submission and notifications, supporting the end-to-end session submission feature.

evaluations.evidence: submit a session ... get my session evaluated
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes admin acceptance/approval and evaluation notifications, providing the complementary evaluation workflow.

evaluations.evidence: personalize my sponsorship page
